content: Penicillin G Sodium for Injection, USP, intended for intramuscular (IM) or intravenous (IV) administration, is provided in a dry powder form. Each vial contains 5,000,000 units (5 million units) of crystalline penicillin G as the sodium salt. The sodium content is 1.68 mEq per million units of penicillin G. The product is available in tray packs of 10 vials, identified by NDC 0781-6153-95, and in tray packs of 50 vials, identified by NDC 0781-6153-97. The dry powder should be stored at a temperature range of 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F), in accordance with the USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines. Once reconstituted into a sterile solution, the product may be stored in a refrigerator at a temperature of 2° to 8°C (36° to 46°F) for up to 3 days without experiencing a significant reduction in potency.
